title: Unanimous Boolean functions
statement: A Boolean function $f\colon\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ is unanimous if it returns $1$ on the input whose coordinates are all $1$, and returns $-1$ on the input whose coordinates are all $-1$.
